reasoning: 驗證使用者將 PAM Alert Mode 設為 Sound 時，TLM 送出 $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.PamAlertMode_Req$ = 1 (Sound) 至 IPC，並更新顯示之設定值。關鍵情境為單一設定值之等價分割（規格段 1205–1206）。本 Req 只述一個值，依 §8.2.2 一 Req 一條，不與另一值合併。規格觸發為內部訊號 Pam_AlertMode_Setting.Req，依 R-P355 不得直接 Set，改以 UI 選擇觸發並驗其下游 CAN 訊號；label 逐字取 DBC VAL_（1 = Sound），規格原文寫 Sound 保留於 verbatim 上半（R-6）。

tcs.tc_title: PAM Alert Mode set to Sound
pre_conditions: The named UI element "Park Sense Setting" screen is displayed
test_procedure: Select "PAM Alert Mode" = "Sound" to trigger $TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.PamAlertMode_Req$ signal transmission
Read the named UI element "PAM Alert Mode" control and check that it is "Sound"
expected_result: The named UI element "PAM Alert Mode" control is "Sound"
tcs.test_item:
The HMI layer shall capture the customer selection for the PAM Alert Mode setting and send the request using CarPropertyManager.setProperty() with the TELEMATIC_VEHICLE_SETUP.PamAlertMode_Req signal value set to Sound
(Alert mode set to Sound is transmitted to the IPC)

distinguishing_axis.delta: PamAlertMode_Req = 1 (Sound)，與同族另一值為等價類之不同分割

tcs.remarks: UI element names are taken from the menu item wording named in the spec section and in the 037 description (R-VL21(a)); they are not anchored in HMI Settings List
